description: How long shots stay on screen. Cuts land on the music's beats, so length is shorter (half), normal or longer (double). The first and last shots have set lengths: a shorter first shot while the opening title is on, or a shorter ending, comes back as a choice for the person (remove the title or an end card, or keep it).

length.description: shorter (half), normal or longer (double), on the music's beats.

photoIds.description: The shots: each a photoId from the edit summary, or a play position like 'shot 3'.

items.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".
